_doc: PATV cosmetics catalog (cosmetics.js). Keep ids stable - owned copies point at them. price is PAT in Pepe's shop (0 = not sold). source: shop | achievement | level | drop | season. unlock gives it free on an achievement id (achievements.json) or a level. season items sell only between from and to (UTC dates, to exclusive). drop_weight = relative odds in Pepe's game drops. item tags (see the tags map) drive the shop filters; kink items are tagged so viewers can hide them, and never drop at random. style is render data per kind; gtf_* items are layers of the pixel avatar (style.layer).
